items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I used to listen to John Kirby coming from New York and Procope, when he had Maxine Sullivan

ctx.x: Uh huh, I have one of the transcriptions someplace at home. But that's about the size of it. I remember Duke and I remember -- I'm speaking now about here in the west -- but now, I used to listen to John Kirby coming from New York and Procope, when he had Maxine Sullivan, you know, and they used to come on every Saturday morning, or something of the sort. But out here, as far as musicians were concerned; that is, the black musicians, I guess I was the one who was fortunate enough to get involved with the studios.
So it was what year that you went on staff?
